resum: Stock markets eased back on Thursday without much drama: the S&P 500 slipped 0.35%, the Nasdaq 0.39% and Spain's Ibex 0.31% to 19,965 points, while Chinese shares were the biggest losers (−1.85% for the China ETF, in dollars). The big story: Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia's CEO, chief financial officer Colette Kress is stepping in on an interim basis, and the stock fell 4.34%.
destacat: When the leader of a giant company suddenly walks out, what matters most isn't the exit itself but whether a successor was ready: trust is built before a crisis, not in the middle of one.
